svg.title: Rectangularize a selected loop
svg.desc: Only the selected closed loop gets a shape; the rest of the island is optimized.. Actual add-on output on synthetic UV geometry. Pink = rectangular constraint; the hole remains open and the shape persists during later optimization.

g.text: Only the selected closed loop gets a shape; the rest of the island is optimized.
Pink = rectangular constraint; the hole remains open and the shape persists during later optimization.
